summary: A 300 mm analog chip fab in Xiamen's Haicang District that Silan plans to run as an IDM line, held by a project company in which Silan is a minority shareholder alongside Xiamen investment partnerships and the national chip fund. Signed in October 2025 with CNY 20 billion over two equal phases, it broke ground on 4 January 2026. Phase 1 targets 240,000 wafers a year, with first line runs in early Q4 2027 and full output in 2030; both phases together are planned at 540,000 wafers a year.

location.note: The plant is in Haicang District.

metrics.note: Two phases of CNY 10 billion each.
Phase 1 project capital is set at CNY 6.01 billion.
300 mm analog IC wafers per year.
300 mm wafers per year after both phases.

milestones.note: Cooperation and investment agreements signed in Xiamen.
Planned initial line connection early in the fourth quarter.
